headline: Approved invoices from LeftField, DesignLab and Consigli for library schematic design services, including $133,295.00 for DesignLab.
summary: Members received a project status update on the library project. Members approved four invoices for schematic design services, with Alderman Johnson opposed to each of the three motions.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the August 4, 2026 meeting. Motion carried.
Approved LeftField invoice #196955 for $19,349.00 and invoice #199897 for $19,350.00. Motion carried, with Alderman Johnson in opposition.
Approved DesignLab invoice #26-06.0826 for $133,295.00. Motion carried, with Alderman Johnson in opposition.
Approved Consigli invoice 1 for $15,451.74. Motion carried, with Alderman Johnson in opposition.

JOINT MEETING – COMMITTEE ON INFRASTRUCTURE and 
LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES 
 
OCTOBER 28, 2026 
 
A joint meeting of the Committee on Infrastructure and Library Board of Trustees was held Wednesday,  
October 28, 2026 at 6:00 p.m. in the aldermanic chamber and duly noticed in two places, including the City’s website, in 
accordance with the requirements of RSA 91-A:2 II. 
 
The roll call was taken with 10 members of the Library Board of Trustees and Committee on Infrastructure present:   
 
 Alderman-at-Large Michael B. O’Brien, Sr. 
 Alderman-at-Large Alicia Gregg 
 Alderman Richard A. Dowd 
 Alderman Paula Johnson 
 Trustee Linda Laflamme 
 Trustee John Kennedy 
 Trustee Kristen Kane 
 Trustee Ernest A. Jette 
 Trustee Scott Jaquith 
 Trustee Patricia Dresner 
     
Members not in Attendance: Alderwoman Vengerflutta Smith 
 Trustee Padmaja Kunapareddy 
 Mayor Jim Donchess 
 Alderman-at-Large Lori Wilshire 
  
Also in Attendance: Tim Cummings, Administrative Serviced Director 
 Jennifer McCormack, Library Director 
 Kayla Gallo, LeftField

• Introductions
